ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark grey/black) with approximately 10-15% high-intensity (white) pixel coverage concentrated in localized scarring and abrasions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity pixels are arranged in discrete circular clusters (rosettes) and elongated, multi-directional linear streaks (rake marks) distributed across both lobes against a low-intensity background.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression with a vertex angle of approximately 45 degrees and a vertical pixel depth of roughly 55-75 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations along the entire trailing boundary, with pixel-amplitudes of peaks and valleys ranging from 5 to 18 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Sigmoidal curve characterized by a medial convexity near the notch transitioning to a broader distal concavity towards the outer lobe tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Presence of numerous circular high-contrast pixel clusters (approximate count >15) localized primarily on the mid-section of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of white, non-parallel linear pixel streaks (rake marks) of varying lengths (50-400 pixels) and orientations across the ventral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive surface trauma manifest as dense linear rake marks and circular pitting/rosette scars across the visible fluke area.
other_distinctive_markers: High-intensity white-water spray and turbulence at the lower-central region occluding the fluke-peduncle attachment site.
